notes.title: Musical inspirations behind Star Overdrive 🎸
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey Star Overdrive riders![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Have you guessed what our musical inspirations behind Star Overdrive?[/p][p]From the very beginning of the game's creative process, composer Andrea Federici began imagining a musical universe inspired by [b]80s rock[/b].[/p][p]The goal was to come up with heavy riffs that you'd want to listen to at full speed and that would take you back in time![/p][p][/p][p][b]AC/DC, Van Halen, Mr. Big, Deep Purple...[/b] All these Rock Legends with their powerful riffs and incisive solos give off a raw energy that we wanted to capture in our game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎧 Listen now on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, and more![/b][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fopen.spotify.com%2Fintl-fr%2Falbum%2F2uAWCdNJI6Bjt9V7CHKCl0%3Fsi%3DTmVsCsyhS0avgcVh7CDoLw"][b]Spotify[/b][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmusic.apple.com%2Ffr%2Falbum%2Fstar-overdrive-1%2F1783666327"][b]Apple Music[/b][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fchannel%2FUCBu0mXovLAdBKJbuRdpt4Tw"][b]YouTube[/b][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.deezer.com%2Fen%2Falbum%2F680493171"][b]Deezer[/b][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]              [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/ef7a7ae1f75c433d8e89ba6f8a4c105991ffdc91.png"][/img]          [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/a3554c39681f6bbb509813f6d22edb4698259176.png"][/img]          [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/6a5fd98739d02216a8b1c1681a5f54cc349743a2.png"][/img]         [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/e8d38e678dc60268b433108cc2102a2948a89eb3.png"][/img]    [/p]

notes.title: Our best tips for getting started with Star Overdrive!
notes.notes: [p]Hi Riders! [/p][p]Welcome to new players discovering the game, here's a list of 5 tips to help you get started! 😊[/p][p][/p][h3]Tip 1: Ride hard![/h3][p]One of the central aspects of the game is your hoverboard. As you cruise the Cebete planet with it, do tricks and jump over the dunes to gain boost! You'll be much faster, and you'll be able to enjoy incredible gliding sensations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/b62e4a8520e26f2df0d59a7720549569ed03be99.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Tip 2: Boost your Hoverboard[/h3][p]Collect crafting components to upgrade various parts of your Hoverboard. Depending on your play style and preferences, these will help you go faster, jump higher, gain strength and so on![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/362f1f100f0478ff3da8bd9035525239cb85d211.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Tip 3: Ride with style[/h3][p]You can customize your hoverboard. Be on the lookout for exclusive designs hidden on the map and in chests! To note: customization isn't just for looks. A freshly painted hoverboard will be more efficient![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/8a98a176fee465b69f2b767b4c278eb79881a4f3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Tip 4: Surf on water[/h3][p]You must have been surprised the first time you tried surfing on water. Surfing on water requires a special crafting componant found in the sandworm's mouth! So collect the Gravitanium by killing your first Sandworm, then upgrade your Hoverboard with it.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/5dc0d395590fc1e8e1d46beb9e3e13aaa6de6b0b.gif"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3]Tip 5: Fights[/h3][p]Let's end this list of tips talking about fights! Throughout the game, you'll unlock powers that you can use to weaken or kill enemies from a distance! You can also attack hand-to-hand with fast and heavy attacks for maximum damage.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/81efac528bf410e4662ad859e74b1e6e7ac66b65.gif"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]After these tips, we hope these tips will help you get started, and that your journey to the planet Cebete goes smoothly! [b]Don't hesitate to share your tips in the comments.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you in Cebete :)[/p]

notes.title: Update - Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes: [p]Hello riders! [b]Patch 1.0.10[/b] is here. Based on your feedback following the game's release, it improves [b]gameplay[/b], [b]fixes various bugs[/b] and [b]adds PlayStation[/b] [b]controller[/b] support on PC. Thanks again for your feedback, which helps us improve the game every day! 🤘[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/74c18d881be87d5ca9fd31bad85a0252cac149ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Changelog[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the QR code for the manga was still shown in the options menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where selecting the tab icons dots with the mouse when in the option menu (coming from the main menu) would make the "back" button stop working and by pressing ESC it would show the in game menu, locking the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with how the component stats bonus is shown in the hexagonal stats chart (the bonus it the one in yellow, activated by having component all of the same design or all of different design). This bonus wouldn't scale visually with the scale shown by the hexagonal chart, now they are scaled accordingly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SPACE BAR as a "confirm" input (in addition to mouse LMB).[/p][/*][*][p]Added ESC as main "back" input (in addition to RMB, but now it shows the icon for esc in the interfaces).[/p][/*][*][p]Added ESC as main "hold to exit" button (in addition to RMB, but now it shows the icon for esc in the interfaces). Used in situations like skipping short cutscenes or leaving the extra section.[/p][/*][*][p]Now skipping the use/leave workbench cutscene uses the same "hold to exit" button as the rest of similar situations (which is now ESC). Before it only used LMB.[/p][/*][*][p]Inside TABs with hexagonal scrollers (hoverboard components, materials in the crafting tab, customization, designs) now the user can move horizontally and vertically to a different component, material etc. by clicking on it with the mouse LMB (in addition to using WASD).[/p][/*][*][p]The when opening the menu during play will place the mouse at the center of the screen instead of the top left for better usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that prevented unlocking the "Ride with style" achievement, when collecting all the hoverboard styles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue that didn't show the correct number of max available styles in the customization section of the workbench.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound effect for the platform devices (inside mines) that move based on the position of the player on the platform itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Now when doing races a second time after winning once will have the time time added with ring reduced from 20s to 15s.[/p][/*][*][p]In the Lambda mine, the initial one with a cross made of rails at the start and a cart in the middle, it was possible to activate the doors by using the wheels even if the cart wasn't close to the wheels. There where also 2 duplicate d4 lasers that have been removed (the only lasers that should be available are the ones generated by pressing the buttons).[/p][/*][*][p]We have added direct support for Playstation controller on PC, with the correct icons appearing. This requires Steam input to be disabled to test it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Join our Community[/b] [/h3][p] [/p][p][url="https://x.com/star_overdrive"]Official Star Overdrive X[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/staroverdrive.com"]Official Star Overdrive Bluesky[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/star_overdrive/"]Official Star Overdrive Instagram[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@star_overdrive"]Official Star Overdrive TikTok[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fdearvillagers"]Dear Villagers X[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fdearvillagers"]Dear Villagers Discord[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2F%40DearVillagers"]Dear Villagers YouTube[/url] [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tiktok.com%2F%40dearvillagers"]Dear Villagers TikTok[/url]  [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fdearvillagers%2F"]Dear Villagers Instagram[/url][/p]

notes.title: The planet Cebete and its secrets 🪐
notes.notes:
[p]In Star Overdrive, exploration is at the heart of the experience and the environment is designed to immerse the player in the adventure.[/p][p]Let's find out what inspired the creation of the game's environment![/p][p][/p][h3]A tribute to Sci-Fi art legends [/h3][p]Our environment is inspired by the work of [b]Roger Dean[/b] and [b]Chris Foss[/b], whose iconic sci-fi art shaped generations of imagination.

notes.title: F.A.Q - Star Overdrive ❓
notes.notes: [p]Hi all! Many of you have played the Star Overdrive demo and given us very positive feedback, thanks a lot for that! 😁[/p][p]Many of you also have questions, so we've prepared a FAQ for you, in the hope that it will help![/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]What is this game?[/b]   [/p][/*][/list][p]Star Overdrive is a high-speed action adventure set in an open world. Race across an alien planet on your Hoverboard, mastering tricks, battling enemies, solving puzzles, and using your powers to overcome challenges and shape your destiny!    [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Is it a single-player, co-op or multiplayer game?[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]It's single player.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]When will the game be released?[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]The game is coming on Steam on June 19th.  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]How much does the game cost?[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p]The game will be €34.99 with a 10% release discount for 2 weeks.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]How many of you are working on the game?[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p]We are a small team of 12 people and we do our best to ensure that you have the best possible experience on the game! 😁[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Are you planning any updates to the demo?[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Yes, an update has already been made based on your feedbacks to make your experience more pleasant and fix some bugs. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Tell me more about the characters.[/b]   [/p][/*][/list][p]Bios, is the main character, he’s looking for his long missing girlfriend Nous. She’s lost on an alien planet called Cebete. You can find more information about Bios on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2055590"]News “Meet Bios”.[/url][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Is the game in Steam Cloud?[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Yes it is![/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Does the game have an original soundtrack? [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2055590"]More infos here[/url][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Does the game include customization options or skins?[/b]   [/p][/*][/list][p]Yes you can customize your hoverboard in game, DLC adds more customization.   [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Can the character be customized? [/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Bios cannot be customized. notes.title: Meet Bios in Star Overdrive 🎸
notes.notes:
Let’s talk about the heart of Star Overdrive: Bios, our main character on this cosmic journey.
If you've played the [b]demo which is available now[/b], you've already caught a glimpse of him, now it's time to meet him!

[h3][b]His mission 🛹
[/b][/h3]Bios is a young man on a mission. After receiving a mysterious signal from his missing girlfriend Nous, he sets off across the galaxy to find her. His destination? The dangerous planet Cebete, where she may be waiting or in danger.

With nothing but Nous’s old Hoverboard and his Keytar, Bios is ready to ride, fight, and play his way through every challenge the universe throws at him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/6cadbe19ad2e3d7dd602b80fdcc467a0f30da6c7.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Music, Style & Power 🎶 
[/b][/h3]
Bios isn’t your typical space hero he's a gamer, and a die-hard fan of 80s rock legends like Van Halen, AC/DC, and Deep Purple. His keytar isn’t just for show: it’s a weapon, a tool, and a source of power that lets him channel music into combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/ec41ca8af2a0f4cf8c53d261ae1a1507a5cc7b37.jpg[/img]

[b]Play the demo now!

notes.title: ⭐ AMA with the devs! ⭐
notes.notes:
[h2]Here are the answers to our recent AMA, straight from [i]Star Overdrive[/i]'s lead developer, Tommaso from Caracal Games. He delves into the game's inspirations, mechanics, and even the story behind the manga! 👀
[/h2]

[table noborder=1]

    [tr]

        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/8bb02553661863e5f628c5f446f78a04875c332f.jpg[/img][/th]

        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/a64b41d715c7d1fa05a17828b2c76279aebf9ecb.jpg[/img][/th]

    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3][b]Do you think this game could be fun for someone that enjoys exploration from open worlds but has very limited time? 
[/b][/h3]We wanted to make a "short" open world, so to complete the game it will only take 10-15 hours instead of 80-100 like other open worlds. We also designed it to be played in short sections with no problems (20-30 minutes maybe? Depends on the player!)

[h3][b]What were the inspirations behind the game? Personally, it gave me strong [i]Trigun [/i]vibes.[/b]
[/h3]
[i]Trigun[/i], we love it! You know that Bios' hair is the result of some iteration that started from Vash the Stampede? They have a different temper anyway 🙂

We grew up in the '90s, so anime and manga are for sure one of the sources of inspiration, directly or indirectly. The very first concept of [i]Star Overdrive[/i] was born after I saw [i]Eureka Seven[/i], an incredible anime in terms of visuals and style—and they’ve got hoverboards, of course. You can see a lot of that in [i]Star Overdrive[/i], but a major part of the world design is inspired by the work of Roger Dean and Chris Foss, incredible illustrators from the last century.

For the music, of course, Van Halen 😉

[h3][b]What's the framerate on the Steam version?[/b]
[/h3]The performance will depend on the hardware running the game. However, Star Overdrive is a very light game, so even on some older machines you should be able to run it very well!

[h3][b]What's the manga about? Is it background info, or a retelling of the plot? I see it available as DLC. Is that the only way to read it?[/b]
[/h3]The manga is a parallel project that we worked on over the past year. We wanted to go a little deeper into the story, taking advantage of this different medium to better show the main character's emotions.

Volume 0 is 180 pages and follows part of the game’s story, but it goes deeper into certain aspects and includes an entire section dedicated to a key prequel event that’s not in the game (only mentioned).

The manga is available as DLC on the e-shop, or you can buy the physical version on Amazon. It's called "[i]Star Overdrive - Beyond the Stars[/i]". It's written by me (Tommaso) and illustrated by the awesome Alfredo Postiglione (an Italian mangaka).

[h3][b]Star Overdrive features a unique mix of traversal and combat. How did you balance hoverboard mechanics with enemy encounters to keep gameplay fluid?[/b][/h3]
Cebete (the planet where[i] Star Overdrive [/i]is set) was designed like a giant skate/hoverboard park, with traversal speed in mind. On top of that, we added points of interest for platforming, puzzles, and combat (like mines and towers), as well as activities related to hoverboard riding (like time trials and races). 

The space between these points is kept consistent to ensure you can ride for a bit before reaching the next area of interest. The center of the map is denser with points (since you go slower with the hoverboard there), and the outer areas are more spread out (because you move much faster later in the game).

The really tricky part—which I’m very happy with (I’m also the level designer)—was that we were able to communicate effectively (but indirectly) where the player should ride and where they should explore on foot. Our testers during development, and feedback from the demo, confirmed that it seems to be working well.

[h3][b]What inspired the power-combination system in combat? 
[/b][/h3]The power system was by far the most difficult—but also the most rewarding—system to develop.

It started, of course, with inspiration from [i]Breath of the Wild[/i]’s power system. But since [i]Star Overdrive[/i] needed more fast-paced action, we wanted the powers to be more integrated into the combat. You can use powers in combat in [i]BOTW [/i]too, but in [i]Star Overdrive[/i], the combat system is based on using powers. They have cumulative effects, not only based on physics, but also on mathematical interactions.

We built the system so that combining powers with enemies, objects, or even the hoverboard always creates a result. During development, we actually discovered several cool mechanics by accident, like the “slingshot,” where you link an enemy/object/hoverboard to two points and then use the grab to charge and throw. It was so fun that we added it into the main quest!

notes.title: 80s inspirations in Star Overdrive 📼
notes.notes:
As we count down to the launch of Star Overdrive, we'd like to celebrate one of the game’s biggest inspirations: the unforgettable [b]energy and aesthetic of the 1980s.[/b]

[h3][b]The music 🎸[/b][/h3]
From the moment you strum your Keytar, Star Overdrive channels the retro-futuristic soul of the '80s. One of the major signatures of the 80s is the [b]game's soundtrack[/b]! Inspired by the great bands and artists of the era, composer Andréa Federici wanted to immerse us as deeply as possible in 80s rock, drawing inspiration from [b]Van Halen, Deep Purple, Mr. Big and AC/DC.[/b]

[h3][b]Hoverboards, Keytar, Polaroid and Tapes 📼[/b][/h3]
Many of the game's mechanics are also linked to the 80s. The main character Bios speeds along on his Hoverboard and performs tricks that defy the laws of gravity, he also fights with his Keytar, and collects tapes and polaroids left by his girlfriend Nous.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171976/7b684ac53413612a0b91c467c1f9e624ea62cdc1.gif[/img]

Whether you’re an '80s kid or just love that timeless synth-powered vibe, Star Overdrive invites you to ride at full speed into nostalgia. Stay tuned for more dev updates, gameplay reveals, and a closer look at what’s waiting for you on Cebete.

notes.title: Star Overdrive (Nintendo Switch) Review
notes.notes:
From the first moment I saw it, I was immediately interested in Star Overdrive. I’ve mentioned before how I have a deep interest in games that use unique forms of movement — or at least put movement at the forefront of gameplay — so a game where you’re sci-fi skateboarding across an alien world seemed like it would be a genuinely fun time.

I honestly thought it wouldn’t be any more straightforward than that, so imagine my surprise when it turned out Star Overdrive is essentially The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, built around the idea of high-speed sandboarding across an alien planet. It’s a great example of a game that’s both surprising for what it is, and a little disappointing for what it could have been.

Star Overdrive begins with the protagonist — a young man named BIOS — drifting (figuratively, not literally) through space when he intercepts a strange distress signal calling out to him specifically. He is pulled toward the desolate planet known as Cebete,... Read more
